d:
Absolute dominance on the turf!
The Indian Men’s Hockey Team signed off from the pool stages in spectacular fashion, storming to an emphatic 8-0 victory over Korea in their final league encounter.
The goals flowed freely in an attacking masterclass, with Dilpreet Singh sparking the charge with a brace, while Jugraj Singh, Harmanpreet Singh, Shilanand Lakra, Sukhjeet Singh, Sanjay, and Angad Bir Singh all found the back of the net to seal a total rout!
